title: Mud is Mud
question: Why did Harry decide to give up his little game?

meanings.usage: 修饰形容词或分词，表示程度
常用于被动语态，表示颜色深浅

meanings.meaning: 观察力敏锐的；善于观察的
meanings.usage: 描述人具有敏锐的观察能力
指有香味的产品或气味
描述非常奇特、不寻常的事物
形容行为或要求过于极端
描述虚构的、不真实的东西
指混合多种东西制成的物品

examples.en: He keeps a large bottle on permanent display in his study.
examples.zh: 他在书房里永久陈列着一个大瓶子。

examples.en: Despite the fact that the bottle is tinted green, an observant visitor would notice it's filled with greyish substance.
examples.zh: 尽管瓶子被染成绿色，敏锐的来访者会注意到里面装的是灰色物质。

examples.en: When Harry put on his act of being mildly annoyed, the assistant promised to order some for him.
examples.zh: 当哈利装出有点烦恼的样子时，店员答应为他订购一些。

examples.en: The woman's eyes immediately lit up and she fetched several bottles.
examples.zh: 那女人的眼睛立刻亮了起来，拿出了好几个瓶子。

examples.en: He beat a hasty retreat, clutching the precious bottle under his arm.
examples.zh: 他匆忙撤退，腋下夹着那个珍贵的瓶子。

examples.en: He was glad to get away with a mere twenty pounds.
examples.zh: 他很高兴只花了二十英镑就买到了。

examples.en: He is fond of relating this interesting story.
examples.zh: 他喜欢讲述这个有趣的故事。

examples.en: He would invent fanciful names on the spot.
examples.zh: 他会当场编造一些稀奇古怪的名字。

examples.en: None of them met with Harry's requirements.
examples.zh: 没有一个能满足哈利的要求。

examples.en: How Harry came into the possession of this outlandish stuff makes an interesting story.
examples.zh: 哈利是如何得到这种稀奇古怪的东西的，这本身就是一个有趣的故事。

sentences.en: My cousin, Harry, keeps a large curiously-shaped bottle on permanent display in his study.
sentences.zh: 我的表兄哈里在他书房里长期陈列着一个硕大而形状奇特的瓶子。

sentences.en: Despite the fact that the bottle is tinted a delicate shade of green,
sentences.zh: 尽管瓶子是淡绿色的，

sentences.en: an observant visitor would soon notice that it is filled with what looks like a thick, greyish substance.
sentences.zh: 细心的来访者很快就会注意到瓶子里盛满了像厚厚的灰白色物质。

sentences.en: If you were to ask Harry what was in the bottle, he would tell you that it contained perfumed mud.
sentences.zh: 如果你问哈里瓶子里装的是什么，他会告诉你里面装的是香泥。

sentences.en: If you expressed doubt or surprise, he would immediately invite you to smell it and then to rub some into your skin.
sentences.zh: 如果你表示怀疑或惊奇，他会立刻请你闻一闻，然后让你往皮肤上擦一些。

sentences.en: The brief experiment would dispel any further doubts you might have.
sentences.zh: 这一短暂的试验会打消你可能有的任何疑虑。

sentences.en: The bottle really does contain perfumed mud.
sentences.zh: 瓶子里确实盛有香泥。

sentences.en: How Harry came into the possession of this outlandish stuff makes an interesting story which he is fond of relating.
sentences.zh: 哈里是如何得到这种稀奇古怪的东西的，说来话长，他本人也乐于讲述。

sentences.en: Furthermore, the acquisition of this bottle cured him of a bad habit he had been developing for years.
sentences.zh: 此外，得到这个瓶子还纠正了他多年来养成的一个坏习惯。

sentences.en: Harry used to consider it a great joke to go into expensive cosmetic shops and make outrageous requests for goods that do not exist.
sentences.zh: 哈里过去认为，到高级化妆品商店去提出一些闻所未闻的要求，寻找一些根本不存在的商品，是一种莫大的乐趣。

sentences.en: He would invent fanciful names on the spot.
sentences.zh: 他会当场编造一些新奇的名称。

sentences.en: On entering a shop,
sentences.zh: 一进商店，

sentences.en: he would ask for a new perfume called 'Scented Shadow' or for 'insoluble bath cubes'.
sentences.zh: 他会要求买一种叫“香影”的新型香水，或“不溶性浴块”。

sentences.en: If a shop assistant told him she had not heard of it, he would pretend to be considerably put out.
sentences.zh: 如果店员告诉他从未听说过，他便会装出相当不悦的样子。

sentences.en: He loved to be told that one of his imaginary products was temporarily out of stock
sentences.zh: 他喜欢听人说他臆造的商品暂时缺货，

sentences.en: and he would faithfully promise to call again at some future date, but of course he never did.
sentences.zh: 他会信誓旦旦地答应改日再来，当然他从来也没有去过。

sentences.en: How Harry managed to keep a straight face during these performances is quite beyond me.
sentences.zh: 哈里在做这些表演时是如何能不露出笑容的，我简直无法理解。

sentences.en: Harry does not need to be prompted to explain how he bought his precious bottle of mud.
sentences.zh: 哈里无需别人提醒就会讲他是如何买到那珍贵的泥巴瓶的。

sentences.en: One day, he went to an exclusive shop in London and asked for 'Myrolite'.
sentences.zh: 有一天，他去了伦敦一家高级商店，要买“美妙来特”。

sentences.en: The shop assistant looked puzzled and Harry repeated the word, slowly stressing each syllable.
sentences.zh: 店员看上去很迷惑，哈里便重复了一遍这个词，并慢慢地重读每个音节。

sentences.en: When the woman shook her head in bewilderment,
sentences.zh: 当那个店员困惑地摇了摇头时，

sentences.en: Harry went on to explain that 'myrolite' was a hard, amber-like substance which could be used to remove freckles.
sentences.zh: 哈里接着解释说，“美妙来特”是一种硬的、琥珀状物质，可以用来消除雀斑。

sentences.en: This explanation evidently conveyed something to the woman who searched shelf after shelf.
sentences.zh: 这种解释显然使那个店员明白了一些什么，她便搜寻了一个又一个的货架。

sentences.en: She produced all sorts of weird concoctions, but none of them met with Harry's requirements.
sentences.zh: 她拿出了各种稀奇古怪的混合物，但没有一样符合哈里的要求。

sentences.en: When Harry put on his act of being mildly annoyed, the assistant promised to order some for him.
sentences.zh: 当哈里装出有点不高兴的样子时，店员答应为他订购一些。

sentences.en: Intoxicated by his success, Harry then asked for perfumed mud.
sentences.zh: 哈里成功后有点得意忘形，接着要买香泥。

sentences.en: He expected the assistant to look at him in blank astonishment.
sentences.zh: 他原以为店员会目瞪口呆地看着他。

sentences.en: However, it was his turn to be surprised, for the woman's eyes immediately lit up
sentences.zh: 然而，这次轮到他吃惊了，因为店员的眼睛立刻亮了起来，

sentences.en: and she fetched several bottles which she placed on the counter for Harry to inspect.
sentences.zh: 拿来了好几瓶放在柜台上让哈里检查。

sentences.en: For once, Harry had to admit defeat.
sentences.zh: 哈里只好承认这次是自己输了。

sentences.en: He picked up what seemed to be the smallest bottle and discreetly asked the price.
sentences.zh: 他拿起看似最小的一瓶，悄悄地问了问价格。

sentences.en: He was glad to get away with a mere twenty pounds and he beat a hasty retreat, clutching the precious bottle under his arm.
sentences.zh: 他庆幸只花了区区20英镑就脱身了，他赶忙溜走，把那瓶宝贝紧紧地夹在胳膊下。

sentences.en: From then on, Harry decided that this little game he had invented might prove to be expensive.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，哈里认为他发明的这个小把戏可能代价太大。

sentences.en: The curious bottle which now adorns the bookcase in his study was his first and last purchase of rare cosmetics.
sentences.zh: 现在他书房书柜上陈列的那个奇特的瓶子是他最后一次购买这种稀奇化妆品。

exercises.prompt: “富于幻想的；想象中的” 对应的单词是？
exercises.explain: fanciful · /ˈfænsɪfl/ · adjective · 富于幻想的；想象中的。描述虚构的、不真实的东西

exercises.prompt: 根据释义和音标拼写单词：观察力敏锐的；善于观察的
exercises.explain: observant · /əbˈzɜːvənt/ · adjective · 观察力敏锐的；善于观察的。描述人具有敏锐的观察能力

exercises.prompt: 补全短语：He was glad to _____ a mere twenty pounds.
exercises.hint: 他很高兴只花了二十英镑就买到了。
exercises.explain: get away with：成功做（某事）；侥幸逃脱（他很高兴只花了二十英镑就买到了。）

exercises.prompt: 补全句子：Despite the fact that the bottle is tinted a delicate shade of _____
exercises.explain: Despite the fact that the bottle is tinted a delicate shade of green, — 尽管瓶子是淡绿色的，

source.en: Despite the fact that the bottle is tinted a delicate shade of green,

exercises.prompt: “表示在过去某一时刻之前一直在进行的动作，强调动作的持续性和未完成性” 描述的是哪个语法点？
options: 过去完成进行时 (Past Perfect Continuous Tense)
现在完成时的被动语态
exercises.explain: 过去完成进行时 (Past Perfect Continuous Tense)：had been + 动词-ing：用于描述持续到过去某一点的习惯性动作

source.title: 过去完成进行时 (Past Perfect Continuous Tense)

exercises.prompt:
选出下面句子的正确中文意思：
The brief experiment would dispel any further doubts you might have.
options: 他们设计了数百种竞赛，使我们能够赢得巨额奖金。
搜捕美洲狮的行动是从一个小村庄开始的，在那里，一位采摘黑莓的妇女看见“一只大猫”离她只有五码远。
这一短暂的试验会打消你可能有的任何疑虑。
警察和工人都很感谢这名学生提供的这条提前消息。
exercises.explain: The brief experiment would dispel any further doubts you might have. — 这一短暂的试验会打消你可能有的任何疑虑。

source.en: The brief experiment would dispel any further doubts you might have.

grammar.title: 过去完成进行时 (Past Perfect Continuous Tense)
grammar.definition: 表示在过去某一时刻之前一直在进行的动作，强调动作的持续性和未完成性
grammar.usage: 用于描述持续到过去某一点的习惯性动作

examples.en: He had been developing a bad habit for years.
examples.zh: 他多年来一直养成一个坏习惯。

grammar.title: if虚拟条件句（与现在事实相反）
grammar.definition: 表示与现在事实相反或不太可能发生的情况
grammar.structure: If + 主语 + were to + 动词原形...
grammar.usage: 用于假设不太可能发生的事情

examples.en: If you were to ask Harry what was in the bottle, he would tell you that it contained perfumed mud.
examples.zh: 如果你问哈利瓶子里是什么，他会告诉你里面装的是香水泥。

grammar.title: 间接引语（陈述句的转换）
grammar.definition: 将直接引语转换为间接引语时，人称、时态、时间状语等需要相应变化
grammar.usage: 叙述他人说过的话时使用，that可省略

examples.en: He said (that) the bottle contained perfumed mud.
examples.zh: 他说瓶子里装的是香水泥。

patterns.pattern: If you were to do..., would/could/might + 动词原形...

original.en: If you were to ask Harry what was in the bottle, he would tell you that it contained perfumed mud.
original.zh: 如果你问哈利瓶子里是什么，他会告诉你里面装的是香水泥。

examples.en: If you were to visit China, you would learn a lot about its culture.
examples.zh: 如果你要去中国旅游，你会学到很多关于中国文化的知识。

examples.en: If you were to practice speaking English every day, you could improve quickly.
examples.zh: 如果你每天练习说英语，你就能快速进步。

patterns.pattern: Despite the fact that + 从句...

original.en: Despite the fact that the bottle is tinted a delicate shade of green, an observant visitor would soon notice that it is filled with what looks like a thick, greyish substance.
original.zh: 尽管瓶子被染成淡绿色，敏锐的来访者很快就会注意到里面装的是看起来像浓稠的灰色物质。

examples.en: Despite the fact that he is very young, he speaks English fluently.
examples.zh: 尽管他很年轻，他的英语说得很流利。

examples.en: Despite the fact that it was raining heavily, we went hiking.
examples.zh: 尽管雨下得很大，我们还是去徒步了。

patterns.pattern: 主语 + love/like + to be told that...

original.en: He loved to be told that one of his imaginary products was temporarily out of stock.
original.zh: 他喜欢听别人说他想象中的产品暂时缺货。

examples.en: She loves to be told that her cooking is delicious.
examples.zh: 她喜欢听别人夸她的厨艺好。

examples.en: Children love to be told that they are clever.
examples.zh: 孩子们喜欢听别人夸他们聪明。

original.en: How Harry managed to keep a straight face during these performances is quite beyond me.
original.zh: 哈利在这些表演中是怎样忍住不笑的，我实在想不通。

examples.en: Why she married him is quite beyond me.
examples.zh: 她为什么嫁给他，我实在想不通。

examples.en: How he passed the exam is quite beyond me.
examples.zh: 他是怎么通过考试的，我实在想不通。
